record.field: select a.iblnr, a.budat, a.gjahr, a.lgort, a.werks, b.zeili, b.matnr, c.maktx,b.bstar, b.menge, b.meins from ikpf a join iseg b on a.iblnr = b.iblnr and a.gjahr = b.gjahr left join makt c on b.matnr = c.matnr where a.gjahr > '2025'

select b.mblnr, a.iblnr, a.budat, a.gjahr, a.lgort, a.werks, b.zeili, b.matnr, c.maktx,b.bstar, b.menge, b.meins from ikpf a join iseg b on a.iblnr = b.iblnr and a.gjahr = b.gjahr left join makt c on b.matnr = c.matnr where b.mblnr != ' ' and TO_DATE(a.gjahr,'YYYY') BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE-100 AND CURRENT_DATE
